component.name: kyko
component.summary: Terminal emulator with a drop-down mode

description.p: kyko is a terminal for uQ and other Wayland desktops. It opens as a normal window or slides down from the top of the screen on one key, and its shells keep running in a small background service, so closing the window or restarting it loses nothing.

ul.li: Tabs and splits, with sessions that survive a restart
Images in the terminal (the kitty graphics protocol and sixel)
Ligatures, emoji and the kitty keyboard protocol
Clickable links, link hints and search
Follows the uQ theme live, with built-in themes elsewhere
